scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
Hey ! My friend !
I see that you are a mage.
Look into yourself to discover
your hidden abilities !
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
嘿，朋友！
看得出你是個魔法師。
探索自己的內心，發掘隱藏的力量吧！

scripts.text: About mage's hidden ability
scripts.translation: 關於魔法師的隱藏能力

scripts.text: About skill ^3355FF' Energy Coat '^000000
scripts.translation: 關於技能^3355FF“能量外套”^000000

scripts.text: End conversation
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
For many years
I have studied the ancient
magic's of Geffen.
Recently, I discovered
a very good forgotten skill! ! !
Isn't that fortunate?
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
多年來，我一直在研究吉芬的古老魔法。
最近，我發現了一項失傳已久的絕妙技能！！！
是不是很幸運？

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
The skill uses your mental
energy to block attacks against you.
It is like a magical shield, or armor.
Only the most special of persons can
use this amazing skills.
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
這項技能能利用精神能量抵擋攻擊，就像一面魔法盾，或一副魔法鎧甲。
只有非同一般的人，才能施展如此驚人的技能。

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
But the most amazing part is that I
can use the skill! ! !
I can use this to protect myself !
Pu hah hah hah !!
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
但最驚人的是，我可以使用這個技能！！！
我可以用它來保護自己！
噗hah hah hah！

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
Ok Ok, don't get too excited.
Listen carefully to what I can tell you.
Those who use this spell must tap
the hidden energies and abilities
locked within themselves !
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
好了好了，別太激動。
仔細聽我說。
想施展這個法術，必須喚醒潛藏在自己體內的能量與能力！

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
If you wish to learn this skill, you
must first have a few items to
be used during the process.
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
想學這項技能，得先準備幾樣修習時要用的物品。

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
three ^3355FFGlass Bead^000000 
one ^3355FF1 carat Diamond^000000 
five ^3355FFShell^000000 
one ^3355FFSolid Shell^000000 
Bring me these items.
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
三顆^3355FF玻璃珠^000000
一顆^3355FF1克拉鑽石^000000
五個^3355FF貝殼^000000
一個^3355FF堅硬外皮^000000
把這些物品帶給我。

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
Also, one more thing. . .
You must be sufficiently experienced
in the magical arts. This means you must
either be a wizard or mage job level 35+.
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
哦，還有一件事...
你必須有足夠的魔法修行經驗，也就是說，必須是巫師，或職業等級達到35級的魔法師。

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
Wizards already have already
experienced the role of a mage
and so do not require a job level.
In any case, one who wishes to
be trained in this art must be in a
healthy and strong mental state.
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
巫師已經經歷過魔法師階段，所以沒有職業等級限制。
不過，無論是誰，想修習這門法術，都必須精神飽滿、意志堅定。

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
Okay . .
There is nothing more to say, are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
好了...該說的都說了，有興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
It seems that you have 
already mastered this skill.
Your skill in 'Energy Coat' 
is evident.
I am sorry, 
I have nothing more to teach you ...
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
看來你已經掌握了這項技能。
一看就知道，你會使用能量外套。
抱歉，我沒什麼能再教你的了...

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
Okay, I have received your request.
I will now awaken your hidden energies . .
. . . . . .
. . . . . . . . . . . . .
. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
好，我答應教你。
現在就來喚醒你體內隱藏的能量...
...
...
...

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
Ancient powers of
Geffen! I seek the enlightenment
and honor of your presence. 
I am humbled in your presence!
 ...
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
吉芬的遠古之力啊！
願你降臨，賜予我啟迪與榮耀。
在你面前，我滿懷謙卑！
...

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
Grant me your power!
Release your spirit
Mana Shield! Metal Armor!
. . . . . . . . . . . .
ENERGY COAT! ! !
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
賜予我力量吧！
釋放你的靈魂！
魔力護盾！金屬鎧甲！
...
能量外套！！！

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
. . . . .
It is done. . .
You know have the 
elite skill of ^3355FF' Energy Coat '^000000 .
Use it well.
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
...
完成了...
你現在已經掌握了高深的技能^3355FF能量外套^000000。
好好運用它吧。

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
Do not shame our
class with disgraceful
use of this or any skill.
Your new power calls for new responsibility.
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
無論使用這項技能還是其他技能，都不可行卑劣之事，讓我們的職業蒙羞。
獲得新的力量，也意味著承擔新的責任。

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
Look!!
Didn't you listen to my explanation ? !
You have not prepared fully
for me to assist you.
Check that you have all the requirements.
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
喂！！
你到底有沒有聽我解釋？！
你還沒準備好，我沒法幫你。
再檢查一下，看看條件都滿足了沒有。

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
If you need me to explain
all this again, then ask me.
I would be happy to explain again
if only you would listen. . .
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
如果你需要我再解釋一遍，就問我吧。
只要你肯聽，我很樂意再解釋一次...

scripts.text:
[BLIZZARDRISS]
The wise man must have patience !
Prepare yourself again,
and return when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[暴雪裡斯]
智者要有耐心！
回去準備，等一切就緒了再來。
